Cooking

Higher cooking skill allows you to learn higher level cooking recipes. Recipes can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and as drops from monsters. 132 recipes in the WoW Forever client, 43 new and 2 changed from Classic.

Other professions: Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Enchanting, Engineering, Leatherworking, Tailoring, Herbalism, Mining, Skinning, First Aid, Fishing

Cooking leveling guide 1-300: what to make at each skill, the shopping list and where to learn each recipe.
